item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-a007cee33f0d9205","start_unit":15,"end_unit":16,"fact_summary":"The coalition government’s reform granting a Chancen-Aufenthaltsrecht took effect before the 2023 period and allowed people with tolerated status who had been in Germany for five years to obtain an 18-month residence permit while meeting ordinary legalisation conditions; by 2023, at least 49,000 had applied, about 17,000 applications had been granted, and 2,100 refused.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","6B.8","8B.2","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The reform entered into force on 31 December 2022; 2023 application and grant figures are directly reported.","ruler_attribution":"The measure is attributed to the coalition government; the source does not identify Olaf Scholz’s personal role beyond his position as federal chancellor.","limitations":["The figures vary between Länder and do not establish long-term outcomes or equitable access."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a007cee33f0d9205","start_unit":15,"end_unit":16,"fact_summary":"In 2023, Germany received 329,120 applications for international protection, while pending BAMF cases rose to 239,614 at year-end; the first-instance overall recognition rate was 68.6%, with rates of 99.9% for Syrians, 98.7% for Afghans, 17.8% for Turkish nationals, and 33.2% for Iraqis.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","8B.7","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The statistics cover 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The outcomes concern the federal asylum system under the coalition government; the source does not establish that Scholz personally directed individual decisions.","limitations":["The increase in applications and backlog reflects external pressures and cannot by itself be attributed to government policy."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a007cee33f0d9205","start_unit":16,"end_unit":17,"fact_summary":"The asylum-procedure reform that entered into force on 1 January 2023 introduced independent counselling, changed interview and appeal rules, and aligned procedural time limits more closely with EU law; however, implementation was delayed, NGO access to arrival centres was restricted by a March 2023 court ruling, and funding for independent counselling was insufficient and lacked a reliable long-term strategy.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.8","4B.4","6B.2","6B.5","8B.2","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The reform and its reported implementation problems concern 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The reform was enacted by the coalition government; the source attributes the access restriction to the Federal Administrative Court and does not establish Scholz’s personal involvement.","limitations":["The report does not quantify the effect of counselling on decisions or legal outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a007cee33f0d9205","start_unit":16,"end_unit":17,"fact_summary":"The federal Afghan humanitarian admission programme was suspended in March 2023 after allegations of misuse and resumed in June with data checks and security interviews; NGOs reported that the suspension and additional screening caused delays and that the programme fell short of its original design.","question_ids":["3B.7","6B.3","6B.6","8B.8","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The suspension, resumption, and reported delays occurred in 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The programme was operated by the Federal Government; the source does not establish a personal decision by Scholz.","limitations":["The source reports NGO criticism but does not provide a complete comparison of planned and completed admissions."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a007cee33f0d9205","start_unit":17,"end_unit":18,"fact_summary":"During 2023, increased arrivals led municipalities to reintroduce emergency shelters, and many reception centres became overcrowded; the report states that conditions were below standards, registration backlogs occurred, and access to health care, social assistance, and adequate support for children became more difficult.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.9","6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The conditions and administrative effects are reported for 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report describes federal and municipal reception conditions but does not isolate decisions personally made by Scholz.","limitations":["The report notes that the Federal Government claimed registration backlogs were being remedied, but provides no independent final assessment."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a007cee33f0d9205","start_unit":18,"end_unit":19,"fact_summary":"From the beginning of 2023, asylum seekers of all nationalities became eligible for integration courses.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.8","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The eligibility change applied from the beginning of 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The source presents this as a federal policy under the coalition government; it does not establish Scholz’s personal authorship.","limitations":["Eligibility does not demonstrate actual participation, sufficient course capacity, or outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a007cee33f0d9205","start_unit":18,"end_unit":19,"fact_summary":"In October 2023, the coalition government introduced the Act to Improve Removals; parliament passed it in January 2024, so its detention, benefits, and labour-market measures were generally not in force during 2023.","question_ids":["3B.5","4B.2","6B.7","8B.1","8B.2"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"The bill was introduced in 2023 but enacted after the target period.","ruler_attribution":"The bill is attributed to the coalition government; the source does not identify Scholz’s personal role.","limitations":["Because the principal measures were not operative in 2023, this is evidence of a proposed programme rather than implemented results."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a007cee33f0d9205","start_unit":20,"end_unit":21,"fact_summary":"Germany’s temporary-protection framework for people fleeing Ukraine was broader than the EU Council decision, covering Ukrainian nationals and certain family members and some third-country nationals resident in Ukraine; nevertheless, the report found that eligible third-country nationals were sometimes denied registration or pressured into asylum procedures and received less favourable access to work and benefits.","question_ids":["3B.7","4B.7","6B.3","6B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The unequal implementation and court disputes are reported during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The framework was implemented by German federal and subnational authorities; the source does not establish Scholz’s personal direction.","limitations":["The report describes administrative practice and criticism but does not quantify the affected population."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a007cee33f0d9205","start_unit":21,"end_unit":21,"fact_summary":"The government distributed multilingual information on entry, legal stay, and housing for people fleeing Ukraine, but the report found no systemic mechanisms to identify applicants with special needs and described continuing administrative delays in residence-permit decisions.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","6B.5","6B.6","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The measures and deficiencies are described as current during the 2023 period.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes information distribution to the German government but does not identify Scholz’s personal action.","limitations":["The report does not measure the reach or effectiveness of the multilingual information."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a007cee33f0d9205","start_unit":23,"end_unit":24,"fact_summary":"As of December 2023, BAMF had 8,447 positions, including 7,355 full-time positions in asylum departments; it also maintained quality-management, operational-management, and special-security functions. BAMF used second-employee checks, random quality controls, and monitoring of branch offices with unusually divergent protection rates, although monitoring results were not automatically public.","question_ids":["4B.4","4B.6","5B.2","5B.7","6B.4","6B.5","7B.6","8B.3","8B.4","8B.5"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Staffing and institutional arrangements are reported as of late 2023.","ruler_attribution":"These are institutional arrangements of BAMF under the responsible federal ministry; the source does not establish Scholz’s personal appointment or oversight decisions.","limitations":["The report does not evaluate whether the controls corrected individual errors or improved consistency in 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a007cee33f0d9205","start_unit":24,"end_unit":24,"fact_summary":"In 2023, BAMF decisions took an average of 6.8 months, while pending applications reached 239,614 at year-end; the average duration was calculated from the date Germany became responsible for the case, and the Dublin procedure itself averaged 3.1 months.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.5","8B.6","8B.7","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The averages and backlog are for 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The figures concern BAMF performance under the federal government; the source does not establish direct personal causation by Scholz.","limitations":["The change in calculation methodology complicates comparison with earlier years."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a007cee33f0d9205","start_unit":27,"end_unit":28,"fact_summary":"By June 2023, border authorities had detected 45,338 irregular entries, including 18,747 people asking for asylum, of whom 16,735 were referred to BAMF; in the first half of 2023, 12,589 people were removed to neighbouring countries after refusal of entry, including 4,489 to Austria.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.8","3B.9","6B.6","8B.5","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The figures cover the first half of 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The actions involved the Federal Police and federal asylum authorities; the source does not establish Scholz’s personal direction.","limitations":["The report records competing interpretations: NGOs alleged illegal pushbacks, while the Federal Government rejected the allegation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a007cee33f0d9205","start_unit":28,"end_unit":28,"fact_summary":"Germany introduced temporary stationary border controls with Poland, the Czech Republic, and Switzerland on 16 October 2023 and extended them in December; NGOs argued that the controls caused refusals of entry and denied some people access to BAMF assessment, while a police union said they shifted routes rather than reducing irregular immigration.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.8","4B.2","6B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The controls were introduced and extended during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The controls were introduced by the Federal Government; the source does not establish Scholz’s personal authorship or decision process.","limitations":["The source reports stakeholder assessments and does not establish the legality or causal effect of the controls conclusively."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a007cee33f0d9205","start_unit":30,"end_unit":31,"fact_summary":"Germany pledged 6,500 resettlement places for 2023 and admitted 4,614 people during the year, including 2,078 through national programmes, 2,098 Syrians from Türkiye, 438 through Berlin and Brandenburg programmes, and 16 through the NesT private-sponsorship scheme.","question_ids":["3B.7","6B.3","6B.6","8B.2","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The pledge and admissions concern 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The commitments and admissions were made through federal and Länder programmes; the source does not establish Scholz’s personal role.","limitations":["Some people admitted through 2023 programmes were expected to enter Germany in 2024, and the source does not explain the full gap between pledge and admission."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a007cee33f0d9205","start_unit":33,"end_unit":34,"fact_summary":"During 2023, asylum registrations exceeded newly expressed asylum requests, indicating that an earlier registration backlog was being reduced; however, asylum seekers who failed to appear at the responsible BAMF branch office could have their procedure discontinued before substantive examination.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.4","6B.2","6B.5","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The backlog reduction and procedural rule are reported for 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The procedures are established in federal law and administered by BAMF; the source does not identify Scholz’s personal involvement.","limitations":["The source does not quantify how many procedures were discontinued or later reopened."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a007cee33f0d9205","start_unit":35,"end_unit":36,"fact_summary":"The Federal Administrative Court ruled on 16 February 2023 that BAMF screening of asylum applicants’ mobile devices was unlawful where less intrusive means could establish identity; the court held that the practice interfered with the fundamental right to confidentiality and integrity of information-technology systems.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.5","4B.4","4B.9","7B.2","8B.8"],"polarity":"exculpatory","period_fit":"The judgment was issued during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns BAMF practice and judicial correction; the source does not establish whether Scholz personally authorised the practice.","limitations":["The later 2024 law proposal to expand phone searches falls outside the target period, although the report notes it disregarded the ruling."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a007cee33f0d9205","start_unit":35,"end_unit":36,"fact_summary":"From January through June 2023, BAMF used language or dialect recognition in 22,947 cases; the Arabic-dialect recognition rate rose to 87%, but NGOs and opposition parties warned that officers might treat probabilistic outputs as facts, performance was weaker for some countries with many local languages, and a promised scientific study had not occurred.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.5","4B.9","6B.5","7B.2","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Usage, performance, criticism, and the missing study are reported for 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The tool was used by BAMF under federal authority; the source does not establish Scholz’s personal direction.","limitations":["The reported recognition rate is not an accuracy measure for all nationalities or cases and does not demonstrate resulting decision errors."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a007cee33f0d9205","start_unit":37,"end_unit":38,"fact_summary":"The 2022 reform required the Federal Office to review an uncertain country situation at least every six months, inform affected applicants of postponement reasons, and notify the European Commission; in 2023, BAMF procedures averaged 6.8 months and the average court procedure was 21.3 months through August.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.5","4B.4","6B.5","8B.2","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The review safeguards derive from the operative reform, while performance figures concern 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The safeguards are statutory and the performance figures concern BAMF and courts; the source does not establish Scholz’s personal implementation decisions.","limitations":["The source does not report compliance rates with the six-month reviews or applicant notification duty."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a007cee33f0d9205","start_unit":40,"end_unit":42,"fact_summary":"In the first half of 2023, first-instance procedures averaged 5.6 months in arrival centres versus 7.6 months overall, while procedures in AnkER centres averaged 6.7 months versus 6.6 months overall; the report therefore found that AnkER centres were not faster in 2023.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.5","8B.6","8B.7","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The comparison covers the first half of 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The centres operate through federal and Länder cooperation; the source does not establish Scholz’s personal management of them.","limitations":["The comparison is descriptive and does not control for case mix or other differences between facilities."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a007cee33f0d9205","start_unit":45,"end_unit":46,"fact_summary":"In the first half of 2023, 715 of 93,015 BAMF interviews, or 0.8%, were conducted by videoconference; the source reports that video-interview decisions had a lower protection rate overall but cautions that the small, uneven sample and branch-office differences could explain the result.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.5","6B.5","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The usage and outcome comparison cover the first half of 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The practice was authorised within the federal asylum system; the source does not establish Scholz’s personal role.","limitations":["The source does not provide a causal estimate of whether videoconferencing affected protection outcomes."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":[],"batch_limitations":["The supplied document is a Germany asylum-system report and provides mostly institutional and coalition-government evidence; it does not establish Olaf Scholz’s personal intent, authorship, or control for most reported actions.","No supplied facts materially address nuclear risk, conventional war initiation or conduct, macroeconomic policy, personal financial integrity, or broad electoral competition beyond asylum-related institutions and rights.","Facts are limited to events, policies, quantitative results, and institutional findings explicitly reported for or materially operative during 2023."]}
